🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-11-26 23:00 → 2026-11-27 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Scope split settled between ERC-8274 and ERC-8299** — 8274 keeps the shared verifier interfaces and the optional judgment profile, while 8299 carries input provenance plus normative judgment-composition requirements. [tg:tawg:6630]

> **ERC-8299 verifier shipped to Sepolia** — ccip-router 0.9.2 brings a v2 proof verifier that checks the signer and adds ERC-8299 domain work. [PR #14](https://github.com/trustless-ai/ccip-router/pull/14)

> **ERC-8299 review vectors replayed clean** — a from-scratch Section 9 rerun on the review branch reproduced every Case 5 vector, hashes included. [tg:tawg:6640]

> **Agentic-commerce vector reached testnet** — a completed ERC-8183 vector now has a CC0 reference contract behind it on Base Sepolia. [ERC-8183 post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/475)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8274 and ERC-8299 split
_A two-draft scope question resolved into complementary mandates._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Proposed** giving ERC-8274 the optional attestation and judgment profile while ERC-8299 stays focused on input provenance, which hands each draft a clean mandate and spares reviewers from adjudicating overlap. [tg:tawg:6609]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Confirmed** the arrangement, keeping 8274's Specification on the common verifier interfaces and the judgment profile optional rather than core, so both documents can advance without stepping on each other. [tg:tawg:6630]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Agreed** to keep judgment-composition requirements normative in ERC-8299's Specification and to make intended_verifier a MUST where consumers depend on it, turning the agreed split into testable normative text. [tg:tawg:6631]

### ERC-8299 implementation
_The verification stack moved from branch work toward a deployed environment._

- **Shipped** ccip-router 0.9.2 with a v2 proof verifier that checks the signer, now live on Sepolia, plus ERC-8299 domain work, so the verification path can be exercised against a real deployment instead of mocks. [PR #14](https://github.com/trustless-ai/ccip-router/pull/14)
- Jimmy Shi **Opened** a tracking issue to sync erc8301 clients with the updated operationId ABI, keeping client libraries from drifting away from the upstream interface. [issue #29](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/issues/29)

### ERC-8299 verification
_The review track shifted from authoring toward independent reproduction._

- Baby Blue Viper **Recomputed** Section 9 on the erc-8299-review branch from scratch and reproduced all Case 5 vectors, including the raw proposal hash, the JCS bytes and the verdict hash, giving the draft outside confirmation that its serialization and hashing path is deterministic. [tg:tawg:6640]

### ERC-8004 and new-ERC drafts
_Review attention turned to how a new credential draft lines up with existing agent identity work._

- Pavlo **Integrated** the pinned ERC-8004 Solidity/Vyper comparison into the verifiable-execution-claim-authorization research, giving the second-backend pilot a fixed cross-language reference instead of a moving target. [PR #16](https://github.com/trustless-ai/verifiable-execution-claim-authorization/pull/16)
- **Reviewed** the proposed Unclonable Agent Execution Credentials draft with a not-mergeable verdict and one blocking comment, handing the authors a crisp gate to clear before the next revision. [review](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1953#pullrequestreview-6082554446)
- Review questions **pressed** on how the guard composes and how the agent identity pair is carried, and flagged asset comments that point past the proposal's definitions, precision that should save a full revision cycle. [review question](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1953#discussion_r4714962471)

### ERC-8183 agentic commerce
_The commerce thread moved from description to runnable artifacts._

- **Clarified** that TaskBoard's refund path runs through its own bounty-refund mechanism rather than an ERC-8183 contract, keeping implementation comparisons honest for builders following the thread. [post 473](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/473)
- **Delivered** the completed ERC-8183 vector with a CC0 reference contract on Base Sepolia, giving the agentic-commerce discussion a reproducible target instead of a sketch. [post 475](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/475)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- Where ERC-8274's optional attestation profile should live once it is no longer core: an annex, a companion document, or an appendix in the Specification.
- Whether the pinned ERC-8004 comparison should extend to the second backend before more pilot results arrive.
- What other teams find when they run the new ERC-8183 vector against their own implementations.

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Clear the remaining blocking comment on the Unclonable Agent Execution Credentials draft and answer the advisory questions before the next revision.
- Re-run the Section 9 replay whenever the review branch changes so the reproduced vectors stay trustworthy.
- Finish syncing erc8301 clients to the updated operationId ABI and close out the tracking issue.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** a two-draft scope question that usually eats a week of review time settled in three quick messages and then turned into concrete normative wording.
>
> Keep that handoff rhythm going and the drafts will practically write themselves — the compiler may still file an objection 😄
